descriptionHtml:
Feature: 7-day weather data is fetched from Open-Meteo

As the team operating the Activity Ranking API, we want the service to ask Open-Meteo for exactly the data it needs and to fail clearly when Open-Meteo misbehaves so that rankings are based on the right forecast and outages are easy to understand.

These scenarios replace Open-Meteo with a WireMock stub and inspect the requests the service sent to it. The service must read the Open-Meteo base URLs from configuration.

Rule: Open-Meteo failures become clear, consistent errors
